feeds.title: Martin's Rugby Coaching Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a great resource for rugby coaches.

feeds.title: Rugby Fitness Training Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Rugby Fitness Training. I am Ben Wilson, I am a conditioning coach and the author of the book 'Rugby Fitness Training: A Twelve Month Conditioning Programme' This website will help you improve your fitness on the rugby field as a player or improve that of your team if you are a rugby coach.

feeds.title: 360 Rugby Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest news and blogs written by Joe and the team from 360 Rugby. Top tips, training advice plus much more! 360 Rugby is a brand new sports coaching company for children that focuses on developing the entire player through term time, Saturday morning coaching sessions held at Eastbourne RFC.

feeds.title: Rugby Speed Coach Blog
feeds.description: We are committed to our athletes and their development. Our concept when coaching is to keep things simple and easy to understand so that you can not only achieve your goals but keep going at it at home without us. On Rugby Speed Coach Blog, qualified strength & conditioning coaches for rugby and league players share helpful tips and blogs to build Explosive Speed and improve on-field performance through speed development.

feeds.title: Ruck Science
feeds.description: At Ruck Science, we don't make products for bodybuilders, fighters or posers. We're about premium-quality supplements for rugby players. This blog is dedicated to giving all ruggers access to the best free training, diet and skill-based resources.

feeds.title: Conversational Rugby
feeds.description: An amateur coach's musings on the game they play in Heaven. Rob Nichol is a Rugby coach and referee, librarian, historian, cyclist, canoeist, photographer, Golden Age film buff, and author.

feeds.title: Rugby Coach Talk Blog
feeds.description: Covers attack and evasion, building a strong team, contact and breakdown, defense, forward play, kicking, position-specific training, and conditioning. Coach Talk provides professional and life coaching services to individuals and organizations.

feeds.title: Mustang Rugby Inc.
feeds.description: Mustang Rugby, Inc. is a not-for-profit corporation formed in 2010 and is dedicated to supporting and advancing college student-athletes playing for the Cal Poly Rugby Football Club. We solicit public support through gifts, grants, and fundraising contributions, in order to help offset annual costs in the club's budget.
